plan.notes: Four appearances give this long film a human presence while preserving sustained narrative momentum through its central progression and payoff. The two interior pauses sit at widely spaced structural turns, with the final act uninterrupted before the outro.

segments.reason: Establish the viewer connection before the logo and let the opening act unfold without interruption.
Allow a brief reflective pause after the first substantial narrative movement, before the film begins its next sustained progression.
Bridge the completed payoff and the final act after leaving the central three-act progression uninterrupted.
Close the viewer connection after the final act has had uninterrupted space to complete the film.
